$comment: SSOT for every on-page threshold used by health/page-inspect-core.mjs and health/seo-page.mjs (seo-uzman, 2026-10-28). Pure data, no logic. The core never reads this file itself (it must run inside a browser extension): the caller loads it and passes it as `rules`. Values live in the group objects; the `evidence` map explains each one. EVIDENCE CLASSES (site-builder/specs/design-canon.md section 0): MEASURED = we measured it ourselves; LITERATURE = a standard, a vendor document or a published study; TREND = industry practice, no primary source; WEBFORGE DECISION = our own call. IMPORTANT: no length below is a Google rule. Google documents that title links and snippets have no length limit and are cut to fit the device width (sources in evidence). Length bands are advisory, severity warn/info only, and never a ranking claim. No band here is MEASURED by us, so none may be hardened into a gate (design-canon: only MEASURED may set a threshold). Consumers: health/page-inspect-core.mjs, health/page-inspect.mjs, health/seo-page.mjs. site-builder/scripts/audit/site-gate.mjs (site-builder-uzman) is expected to read title.min/max and metaDescription.min/max from here (handoff 2026-10-28); content/head-signals.mjs still hardcodes 30/60/120/160 (same values).

title.min.note: Lower edge of the band already used by content/head-signals.mjs (K23). Google states no minimum (https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/title-link).

title.max.note: Moz (fetched 2026-10-28): keep titles under 60 characters and about 90% display fully; Moz study of 57,832 titles, Google rewrote 58% (third-party study, not reproduced here; the 90% figure is Moz's). Google: titles are truncated as needed to fit the device width, no length limit (https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/title-link, local copy knowledge/google-search-central/appearance__title-link.md).

title.idealMin.note: Moz: aim for 51-60 characters to minimise rewrites. Value is the legacy seo-page.mjs ideal band lower edge, kept so scores do not shift.

title.softMin.note: seo-page.mjs scoring only: 'acceptable' band lower edge (legacy value, no external source).

title.softMax.note: seo-page.mjs scoring only: 'acceptable' band upper edge (legacy value, no external source).

metaDescription.min.note: Moz (fetched 2026-10-28): ideal length 120-160 characters (the same Moz page elsewhere says 50-160 or about 680 pixels; Moz is internally inconsistent). Google: no limit, truncated to device width (https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/snippet, local copy knowledge/google-search-central/appearance__snippet.md). Google also rewrites descriptions it finds poor or off-intent.

metaDescription.max.note: Moz: longer than 160 risks being cut off. Not a Google rule.

metaDescription.idealMin.note: Legacy seo-page.mjs ideal band (150-160), kept so scores do not shift. No source found for 150 specifically.

headings.maxH1.note: Single H1 is our page-anatomy rule. Google does NOT treat several H1s as a problem (google-fundamentals/heading-order-not-ranking, GF-HEADING-ORDER-NOT-RANKING), so the finding is clarity advice, never a ranking claim.

viewport.minMaximumScale.note: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.4 Resize Text: text must be resizable up to 200 percent (fetched 2026-10-28). user-scalable=no or maximum-scale below 2 blocks that. Lighthouse uses its own limit; not re-verified here.

charset.maxByteOffset.note: HTML Standard (fetched 2026-10-28): the character encoding declaration must be serialized within the first 1024 bytes.

hsts.minMaxAgeSeconds.note: hstspreload.org (fetched 2026-10-28): preload eligibility needs max-age of at least 31536000 (1 year), includeSubDomains and preload. We use the 1-year max-age as the 'strong' bar; includeSubDomains/preload absence is info only.

openGraph.required.note: Open Graph protocol (fetched 2026-10-28): required properties for every page are og:title, og:type, og:image, og:url.

twitterCard.required.note: Not re-fetched in this task: the card type is the one key X reads that OG cannot supply; other fields fall back to OG. Unverified, severity info only.

content.thinContentWords.note: Info only. Google has no word-count target (GF-NO-WORD-COUNT-TARGET). Per-page-type floors live in content/page-signals.mjs.

content.minTextHtmlRatioPercent.note: Common SEO-tool heuristic; I do not have a verified primary source and Google does not use a text-to-HTML ratio. Info only.

content.keywordDensityMaxPercent.note: No published number exists; Google's spam policy names keyword stuffing without a figure (https://developers.google.com/search/docs/essentials/spam-policies). Info only.

content.keywordMinTokenLength.note: Tokens shorter than 3 letters are ignored in the keyword table.

images.requireDimensions.note: Explicit width/height attributes reserve space and prevent layout shift (CLS). Not re-fetched in this task.

trackers.note: Signatures are by script src or inline init call. A tag loaded inside a GTM container is invisible to this scan. Patterns were written from known vendor snippets; checked against unit fixtures and the live tariktunc.com source (only GTM is in the source; the other tags load through the container).
